title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash Released: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash featuring speed boosts, a 50% price reduction through year-end, and major algorithmic intelligence improvements across API, AI Studio, and Antigravity.

OpenAI Previews Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol: OpenAI and Cerebras previewed GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast running at up to 750 tokens/sec (14x faster than standard processing) and completing Humanity's Last Exam in under 11.5 hours.

Grok 4.6 Limits Reset & Coding Efficiency: Elon Musk announced Grok reset usage limits for users during the Grok 4.6 launch while showcasing developer benchmarks demonstrating 10x cost reductions for complex automated tasks.

Claude Maintenance Routines & Code Auto-Continue: ClaudeDevs rolled out auto-continue for desktop usage limits, while Boris Cherny detailed automated Claude maintenance routines that merged 180 PRs across production repositories.

Global Markets & Macro Developments: Iran requested a US Congressional inquiry into presidential family insider trading allegations, while US Fed officials advocated for rate hikes and trade enforcement expanded.

items.title: @OfficialLoganK: Gemini 3.7 Flash Launch
items.body: Google introduced Gemini 3.7 Flash, offering significantly faster speed, a 50% price reduction through year-end, and notable intelligence upgrades powered by algorithmic enhancements across AI Studio, API, and Antigravity.

items.title: @cerebras: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast Preview
items.body: Cerebras and OpenAI previewed Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, generating up to 750 tokens per second (14x faster than standard processing) and completing Humanity’s Last Exam in 11h 11m.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.6 Usage Reset & Benchmark Cost Reductions
items.body: Elon Musk announced free usage limit resets during the Grok 4.6 launch, highlighting developer benchmarks showing Grok 4.6 executing complex agentic plans at 1/10th the token cost of prior implementations.

items.title: @bcherny: Autonomous App Maintenance with Claude Routines
items.body: Boris Cherny detailed experiments using Claude routines in Slack for crash fuzzing, duplicate unification, and dead-code removal, resulting in 388 pull requests opened and 180 merged across mobile, desktop, and web codebases.

items.title: @ClaudeDevs: Auto-Continue Checkbox for Limit Resets
items.body: ClaudeDevs introduced an auto-continue feature in Claude Code desktop, allowing long-running tasks to automatically resume once usage limits reset.

items.title: @Im_IrushiK: Anthropic Usage Limit Schedule
items.body: Developers shared reminders regarding Anthropic's upcoming usage limit adjustments scheduled for August 19th across tiered developer accounts.
